I'm looking at code and it seems fine as long as the genesis state has an assumed valid payload hash. Not sure how this plays with ELs though Teku shouldn't have any issues with this. The payload in the genesis state would just have to match one the EL has (most likely the EL genesis block). I must be missing something as I don't really see why this wouldn't just work... Isn't this essentially the same as checkpoint sync from the `merged` state that CL clients already support? Yes, this is exactly what we did in Rayonism. All devnets and the final testnet started with `ExecutionPayloadHeader` in the genesis state corresponding to the EL genesis. All clients supported it by that time In a way, yes. I'm not sure of how the codebase is organized and if we can piggy back off of that functionality :/ Awesome, so there are no objections to having such a feature. We'll test it out and create issues in client team repo's in case the functionality doesn't exist.
